newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Cetes rate falls after overly high close.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Cetes rate falls after overly high close.

text.p: Mexican overnight Cetes rates were down 50 basis points at 23.50 percent in early trade on Monday, from what dealers and analysts said was a high prior closing rate.
"Overnight rates closed very high on Friday. Today we may see rates near to 23.50 percent, but under pressure nonetheless," a fixed-income analyst said.
Another analyst noted that a sign of pressure was that overnight Cetes stood higher than Friday's average trading rate of about 22.75 percent.
